answer: Random beacon audits give each agent a compute heartbeat: each epoch a public beacon picks 1 in 20 agents to prove, within 30 seconds, a fresh pulse of real work. Pass costs one cheap check; fail freezes the bond. Like water carving karst, audits expose hollow shells: an attacker with 100 fake islands must answer 100 pulses at once, each a 10-unit stake, a 1,000-unit burn no bot farm survives. Honest agents pass once and keep their full reward.
